Name: Teyla's Mead Icons
Author: Teylahime
Description:
About a year ago, I made a set of mead icons for the vanilla flowers, unfortunately at the time BAGI didn't support mead icons. Coming back to Stardew modding I found out that DaLion made Better Mead Icons, and so I quickly packed it together into a proper mod.
The rough idea so far is that the more expensive flowers and honeys will end up with mead bottles that look more distinct (color, shape, etc) from plain mead. I'll be expanding it to cover other modded flowers as I go through my current playthrough.

[b][size=4]Currently Covered:[/size][/b]

All Vanilla flower crops
Vanilla Forage-able Flowers
﻿-Requires other mods to support them as honey, either something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses [/url]or something that adds them as a flower crop like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2815]Forage to Farm
[/url]﻿ ﻿-To support Dandelions and Daffodils with just Better Beehouses, they need to be reclassified as Flowers rather than Forage, using something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4674]More than Forage
[/url]
